applicabilityBasis.summary: mGLO is structured as a NAV-linked Luxembourg securitisation-compartment security token (Compartment mGLO, ISIN LU3357216087) referencing Fasanara SA SICAV-RAIF mGLOBAL Fund SF 36 Class A USD ACC, with NAV-priced issuance and redemption. Foreign structuring and variable NAV do not by themselves establish a categorical security exclusion under the U.S. securities statutes incorporated by GENIUS Act section 2(22), and the exact offering memorandum naming the legal issuer and redemption covenants was not independently recovered because Midas web pages returned HTTP 403. Applicability therefore remains unclear.

Its security-token label and Luxembourg securitisation structure are not a qualified U.S. securities determination under GENIUS Act section 2(22), so applicability stays unclear.
